messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High suspicious auth activity detected on auth-proxy from 54.23.12.45 — 6k req/min, spike in 401->200 transitions. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/inbox/4412345678
sam: ACK, paging sec oncall @kevin and creating bridge
kevin: I'm on call, taking lead. creating bridge https://meet.redwood/bridge/4412345678 and joining now
linda: quick context — same IP seen across edge-eu + edge-us-west. user agents vary, looks like credential stuffing or token replay
maria: running a quick query to enumerate tokens seen by that IP
maria: ```sql
select token_id, last_seen, service, status from auth_logs where src_ip='54.23.12.45' order by last_seen desc limit 50;
```
maria: results: 12 distinct token_ids, 8 are svc account tokens (svc::). 3 show recent successful auths. escalating infra + ops
kevin: rotate service tokens for svc-* immediately. command to run on ops bastion:
```bash
./ops rotate-keys --service auth-proxy --selector "svc:*" --reason "suspected-exfil-54.23.12.45" --noninteractive
```
kevin: kicking that now. tagging secops and legal for retention/assessment
sam: applied temporary rate-limit (429) for offending /auth endpoints from 54.23.12.45 and added WAF rule to block UA patterns matching the spike. :lock:
linda: customer impact note — internal background jobs using those svc tokens may see failures. opening INC-2026-1126 and preparing cust comm draft for affected tenants
kevin: @support-team please prepare targeted notices for tenants that have svc tokens rotated; include how to get new creds if needed
legal-team: @kevin preserve all logs and snapshots; collect chain-of-custody for tokens and S3 artifacts. we may need to asses PII exposure
maria: saved query results and raw traces to s3://secops/forensics/4412345678/ and locked down ACLs. checksum: md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
kevin: rotation run completed for 6 svc tokens; config rollout succeeded across regions, monitoring deployments for auth failures
sam: monitoring metrics + alerts for 30m. if no replays, we'll transition to postmortem and remediation backlog
security-pager: acknowledged. will create follow-up card for Monday oncall to perform full audit and implement automated svc detection
kevin: recap for record — blocked offending IP ranges, rate-limited endpoints, WAF rule added, rotated impacted svc tokens, saved forensics, legal notified, customer comms drafted. moving to monitoring phase
linda: action items: postmortem owner @maria, customer comm owner @sam, infra to add automated svc token reuse detection + one-click rotate playbook
sam: :thumbsup: closing bridge in 10m unless new alerts surface. keep running details in this thread
incident-bot: alert correlation shows lower volume; original alert status: resolved. follow-up ticket created INC-2026-1126
